Append durable memories to the home-directory file `~/memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md`; if the file does not exist, create it with `muse.write` using `mode="append"`. Do not use overwrite mode. Preserve existing entries; if later context corrects or supersedes an earlier memory, append a new correction or update entry.
